why.rationale: The pair-relay primitive's quality-without-a-name lives in one decision: the envelope is structural, not decorative. Each stage's handoff packet — surfaced in <=24 lines drawn ONLY from declared fields — is the operator's checkpoint, the schema's guarantee, and the relay's rhythm in one artifact. Strip surfacing and the relay becomes a parallel chain with extra steps. The 'declare -> inspect -> confirm' cadence (stages 0/N share construct) is the formal property that distinguishes this from parallel; max_cycles >= sequence.length is the invariant that protects it. Interactive mode's FIFO + WAITING-OPERATOR side-channel is the load-bearing affordance.
decisions_considered: Surface budget: <=24 lines / <=80 cols is tight enough to force discipline but loose enough to carry the WHY
Field provenance: SDD 2.1.3 names exactly six envelope fields for summary content - drift from that list is taste violation
Convergence locus: operator-judged via convergence_criteria text is the correct seam
Schema invariant max_cycles >= sequence.length: this is the formal anti-degeneracy rule
Same-construct-revisit (stages 0 and N share slug): the canonical 'A->B->A' rhythm is the whole point
